answer_1.quote: Research on enabling a machine to have meaningful and natural conversations with humans plays a fundamental role in developing artificial general intelligence, as can be seen in the formulation of Turing test.

answer_2.quote: We propose holistic metrics that evaluate distinctive aspects of generated dialogues.

answer_3.quote: We propose to recruit and fine-tune GPT-2 as a basis of our quality metrics.

answer_4.quote: we utilize Amazon Turk to collect high quality human ratings from 10 subjects.
answer_4.guideline: each datapoint is to be rated from 1 to 5, with 1 being the worst and 5 being the best on each metric.
